description: Shred an RFP or solicitation into a numbered requirement list with a gap preview. Paste text or upload a PDF or DOCX. AI extraction can miss requirements and every requirement needs human review. This starts an analysis job and returns a result token; call get_shred_result with the token to read the requirements. Free, no sign-in. Limited to 5 shreds per day, shared with the web shredder.

data.description: Base64 file contents, up to 2 MB.

processingConsent.description: Must be true: confirms the source may be processed to extract requirements.

source.description: Where the solicitation came from, up to 500 characters.

text.description: Solicitation text, 40 to 300000 characters. Provide text or file.

title.description: Short title for the solicitation, up to 200 characters.

name: shred_rfp
title: Shred an RFP
